verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents a customer portal for viewing transactions and supports recurring invoices. Nothing in the evidence shows customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel a subscription themselves through that portal or through embeddable components. The portal is an adjacent feature, not self-service subscription lifecycle management.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
